notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone we're back with a small but highly requested update.

- After getting one of the main endings(Saint, Demon, Soulless, Snake) you will notice something new at the front of each cavern that'll allow you to skip answering the questions. 
- We also fixed a couple bugs and typos that we found.

Future

We're also working on more content for WIWI, but we're also working on our next game, Born Into Fear, so development will be a little slow.
